contact.evidence_quote: Patricia Thomas, the President of Sun Path Products Inc., and the entire staff would like to say thanks for stopping by our little home on the World Wide Web. Take a look at our product line, read about our many different comfort, style, and of course safety features, and if you are interested in trying out one of our harness containers for yourself, contact us. Find out for yourself why some of the world’s most recognizable skydiving organizations put their trust in us and our products!
